title: ICAI Announces One-time Opportunity for CA Final Pass Candidates to Complete Virtual Advanced ITT and MCS Courses for Membership
content:
# ICAI Announces One-time Opportunity for CA Final Pass Candidates to Complete Virtual Advanced ITT and MCS Courses for Membership

Ek important update hai! The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne CA Final pass candidates ke liye ek special one-time opportunity announce ki hai. This measure allows eligible candidates to complete their pending Virtual Advanced Information Technology Training (Adv. ITT) and Management & Communication Skills (MCS) courses to apply for ICAI membership.

This is a significant relief for those who cleared their CA Final Examination before the New Scheme of Education came into effect on July 1, 2023, but could not apply for membership due to incomplete Adv. ITT and/or MCS courses.

Here are the key details:

*   **Who is Eligible:** CA Final pass candidates who cleared their exam before July 1, 2023, and have not yet completed the mandatory Adv. ITT and/or MCS courses.
*   **What's the Opportunity:** Complete the Advanced ITT and MCS courses virtually through ICAI's Digital Learning Hub (DLH).
*   **Registration Start Date:** August 1, 2026.
*   **Registration End Date:** June 30, 2027.
*   **Course Completion:** Each course (Virtual MCS and Advanced ITT) has a duration of 15 days, and candidates must complete it within 30 days of registration.
